title: Highly recommended
text: We went for a bachelorette party. The organizers were very attentive and adapted to each customer both in drinks and treatment or language. In our case the workshop was in Catalan. Miss a few popcorn or chips as a detail. I would recommend this event for a birthday, a farewell, a team building for companies. I am not to paint but I like and more do something personalized and practical in good company. Thank you!

title: Different plan
text:
My friends and I went to do the tote bag activity and we really loved it. Super entertaining, with music and drink, and it flew past us.

It’s a different and fun plan to make with friends, as a couple or even as a family. We laugh a lot and you also take something done by you, which is always excited.

Highly recommended, sure we repeat 🤍
author: lids08

title: A unique and super fun experience in Barcelona
text:
An amazing night! We went with some friends not quite sure what to expect and left delighted. The painting and wine activity at Academia de Mars is the most: they give you all the material, they serve you wine or whatever you prefer, there is great music in the background and the Mood is relaxed and creative.

I hadn’t painted since school, but the team guides you step by step (and without burdens!) so in the end I ended up with a picture that I even hung at home 😄. We also laughed a lot, took cool pictures and met very nice people.
